name: Chilling Aura
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level druid 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.

Area aura centered on you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create an aura of frost. All creatures within the aura take a -5 penalty on saving throws against spells or effects with the cold descriptor or that deal cold damage. Additionally, all cold damage in the area is increased by 3 per cold damage dice dealt.
